summary: Created 5-phase implementation plan for strong completeness of minimal, intuitionistic, and classical propositional logics. Phase 1 defines shared infrastructure (SetDerivable, semantic entailment defs). Phases 2-4 prove strong completeness for each logic independently (parallelizable). Phase 5 runs full CI verification. Estimated 480-630 lines across 4 new Lean files, 6 hours total effort.
